title: CLEANUP: cbor_write_head -1 return mapped to ERR_NOMEM should be ERR_CBOR
description: Throughout encode_cbor_payload (src/wp11_keystore.c), every call to cbor_write_head that returns -1 (buffer too small) is mapped to WP11_KEYSTORE_ERR_NOMEM. Buffer overflow is not a memory allocation failure. The correct code is WP11_KEYSTORE_ERR_CBOR (malformed/unfit CBOR) or a new WP11_KEYSTORE_ERR_OVERFLOW. A caller diagnosing WP11_KEYSTORE_ERR_NOMEM will check malloc/mlock paths and miss that the keystore payload is simply too large for the encode buffer. Fix: change all 'return WP11_KEYSTORE_ERR_NOMEM' in encode_cbor_payload to 'return WP11_KEYSTORE_ERR_CBOR'. Add a comment on the affected returns: 'CBOR encode overflowed the pre-allocated buffer — should not happen given the buffer sizing in wp11_keystore_create.'
